title: fix(replay): make owner verification repeatable
body:
## Summary

Fix item 2 of [kumagi's replay-workspace handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18978663), starting from current main `d8e0f83f00191df62174b641e9fff055c357f641`, priority revision 6.

For `half-stage-evacuation` and `source-partner-residual-exchanges`:

```diff
- registered check reuses {package}/_work/registered-check
+ registered check allocates and cleans a fresh temporary workspace
+ explicit --work retains diagnostics and refuses existing paths
```

Both `verify(work)` proof bodies are byte-for-byte unchanged. Scientific inputs, pinned evidence, source archives, shared runner and selected frontier are unchanged. The scoped regression, historical source pins, commands and open Windows handoff are in [`research/owner-replay-workspaces`](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/4471aa49f9f0dd9332b0f1819bead8e331e824db/research/owner-replay-workspaces). Credit kumagi for discovery and the original packages' retained contributor chain.

## Evidence

- Before: each registered command passes once, then exits 1 with `FileExistsError` in `work.mkdir()`.
- After: both real registered commands pass twice in the same checkout, with identical repeated stdout, original owner/moment/rejection checks, no leaked temporary output and unchanged preexisting data.
- `python3.12 -I -Werror -B research/owner-replay-workspaces/verify.py --full` passes seven lifecycle groups plus all four real replays.
- The registered quick hook, 9 replay-selection tests, 26 onboarding tests and Ruff on the new regression pass. Quick controls also pass on Python 3.13 and optimized Python 3.12.
- Metadata/source-pin checks pass for all three packages. Publication-byte checks pass for the exact commit, covering 12, 120 and 105 files respectively.

Checked on Linux x86_64/WSL2, CPython 3.12.15. Scope and overlap freshness are recorded in `TASK.json`; this is a lifecycle repair, not a speedup or supplier-admission claim.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast radius:** verifier-CLIs.

Default temporary mode discards diagnostics even on failure; explicit `--work /fresh/path` preserves them. Hard kills can bypass cleanup. Native Windows and hosted CI are not claimed passed. Full native/global/outer cold replay was not rerun. Existing body-only lint findings remain documented and unsuppressed. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.
